item.title: Three Crookston Freshman receive Superior ratings in the Region 8 Vocal contest
item.description: Three freshmen members of the Crookston High School concert choir participated in the 2026 Minnesota High School League Region 8 Vocal Contest in East Grand Forks on Wednesday. All three received a Superior ranking for their judged performance.
